Small habits repeated every day add up to big changes over time.|Cambodia has a wide variety of landscapes, from the sunny beaches of Kep and Sihanoukville to the green hills of the Cardamom Mountains. Travelers can explore the temples of Angkor, take a boat across Tonle Sap lake or walk through the busy streets of Phnom Penh. Every province has its own character.|Learning to touch type is a useful skill for anyone who works with a computer. Once you get used to it, you no longer need to look at the keyboard, your typing speed rises and you make fewer mistakes. Practice for about fifteen minutes each day, focus on accuracy first and then slowly build up your speed.
